package openfields_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	goahttp "goa.design/goa/v3/http"
	genclient "open-fields.example/gen/http/sample/client"
	genserver "open-fields.example/gen/http/sample/server"
	gensample "open-fields.example/gen/sample"
)

func TestGeneratedEncoderPreservesOpenSibling(t *testing.T) {
	req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/echo", nil)
	value := []byte(`{"integer":9007199254740993123456789}`)
	err := genclient.EncodeEchoRequest(goahttp.RequestEncoder)(req, &gensample.Question{Message: "Choose", Extensions: map[string]json.RawMessage{"extra": value}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, err := io.ReadAll(req.Body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := req.Body.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Contains(encoded, append([]byte(`"extra":`), value...)) || bytes.Contains(encoded, []byte(`"Extensions"`)) {
		t.Fatalf("open sibling was not preserved: %s", encoded)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedDecoderPreservesOpenSibling(t *testing.T) {
	value := []byte(`{"integer":9007199254740993123456789}`)
	req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/echo", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"message":"Choose","MESSAGE":"extra value","extra":{"integer":9007199254740993123456789}}`))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	got, err := genserver.DecodeEchoRequest(goahttp.NewMuxer(), goahttp.RequestDecoder)(req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got.Message != "Choose" || string(got.Extensions["MESSAGE"]) != `"extra value"` || !bytes.Equal(got.Extensions["extra"], value) {
		t.Fatalf("open sibling lost: %#v", got.Extensions)
	}
}
